candidates.statement: Checkout 502s trace to inventory's redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, propagating ReadTimeout through inventory and order to gateway /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis-side metrics/logs absent; whether the timeout stems from redis saturation vs network is unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timeouts (~2s) in inventory cascading as ReadTimeout to order and 502 at gateway /v1/checkout; metrics show elevated p95 (~2.4s) and 502s on checkout. Topology confirms gateway->order->inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side latency/error metrics for the incident window
Inventory service logs confirming redis client timeout cause
